title: Clinician Perceptions of CGRP-Targeted Therapies in Migraine
intro: Thank you for participating. This survey takes approximately 10 minutes. Your responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your primary clinical role?
How many years have you been treating patients with migraine?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.

questions.text: Which of the following therapies for migraine are you aware of?
What is your most important consideration when selecting a therapy for a patient with migraine?
questions.logicNote: PROGRAMMER NOTE: Present options in the exact order listed above. Do not randomize.

questions.text: Which migraine therapy do you prescribe most often?
questions.logicNote: PROGRAMMER NOTE: The brand selected in Q3 must be piped into the text of Q4.

questions.text: How satisfied are you with [PIPE: Q3 selection] for your migraine patients?

piping.note: Replace [PIPE: Q3 selection] with the brand chosen in Q3.

questions.text: Please rate your agreement with each of the following statements.
rows: CGRP-targeted therapies have transformed migraine management
Prior authorization requirements delay my patients' access to newer therapies
I am comfortable using these therapies in patients with cardiovascular risk factors

questions.text: What percentage of your migraine patients currently receive a CGRP-targeted therapy?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

questions.text: In your view, what is the single biggest barrier to your patients’ access to CGRP-targeted therapies?
How likely are you to recommend CGRP-targeted therapy to a colleague treating migraine?
questions.instruction: 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely
